B Urban Development: Chandigarh Housing Board (Allotment, Management and Sale of Tenements) Regulations, 1979. C Regulation 6(/)-Allotment of residential plot-By Housing Board­ Eligibility-Regulations of the Board disqualified a person for allotment of residential plot if he or his spouse residential flats above D a commercial plot with due permission-Held: Words "residential house" in the Regulation covered such residential flats also-Hence, applicant not eligible for allotment of a residential plot-Haryana Housing Board Act, 1971, S.74.
